dataset.note: WeedMap: sugar beet fields in Germany (Rheinbach) and Switzerland (Eschikon); Rheinbach subset used (Eschikon lacks blue channel); 5-fold cross-validation over orthomosaics, pseudo-ground-truth training.

F1.quote: Evaluated on the WeedMap dataset, RoWeeder achieves an F1 score of 75.3, outperforming several baselines.
F1.ambiguity: Macro-averaged F1 (75.3) from abstract; decoder ablation on field 003 reaches up to 77.2 (Flat, interpolation+add); supervised upper bound 82.8. Best-model per-table values differ by configuration - headline claim used.

edge.device: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (consumer GPU; paper targets Jetson TX2/Nano)

fps.table: Table 3: Computational cost comparison between RoWeeder and computational baselines
fps.ambiguity: Derived FPS = 1000/7.07 ms (RoWeeder SegFormer config). Paper reports only ms. Measured on RTX 4090, not an actual edge device.

latency_ms.table: Table 3: Computational cost comparison between RoWeeder and computational baselines
latency_ms.ambiguity: Inference time 7.07 ms (SegFormer config) measured on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090; paper notes RTX 4090 is more powerful than a typical edge device.

params_M.table: Table 3: Computational cost comparison between RoWeeder and computational baselines
params_M.ambiguity: Params(M) = 3.71 for SegFormer-B0 config; flat config 3.60M, pyramid 3.90M.

issues: gflops uses GMACs (7.84 for SegFormer; 3.68 flat) - multiplicative-accumulate, not GFLOPS, so left unreported. Per-class F1 (Table 1) broken out by full/inter-row/intra-row fields for only some configs; not tied unambiguously to the headline config, so weed_F1/crop_F1 left unreported. FPS derived [derived:true] from latency_ms on RTX 4090.
